def count_bananas(image):
    import numpy as np
    from groundindoh.models import GroundingDINO

    # Load the model with default parameters
    model = GroundingDINO('tiny')
    model.load('models/tiny')

    # Load the image
    image = np.array(image)

    # Perform object detection
    execution = model.predict(image)

    # Find the detection confidence map
    detection_confidences = np.max(execution['scores'], axis=0)

    # Find the detections in the image
    detections = np.where(detection_confidences > 0.35)

    # Filter out the detections of objects not of interest
    detections = detections[0].tolist()

    if detections:
        # Calculate the bounding box of the banana
        bottom_left = np.min(detections, axis=0)
        top_right = np.max(detections, axis=0)

        # Calculate the bounding box of the banana
        height, width = np.max(top_right) - np.min(bottom_left), np.max(top_right) - np.min(top_right)
        top_left_x, top_left_y = np.min(bottom_left), np.min(top_left_x)
        bottom_right_x, bottom_right_y = np.max(top_right), np.max(top_right)

        # Extract the bounding box of the banana
        banana_box = (top_left_x, top_left_y, width, height)

        # Calculate the total number of bananas
        total_bananas = len(banana_box)

        return total_bananas

# Example usage
image_path = "/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_23_image_1.jpg"
